jobs_results.title: Junior Python Developer (Pharmacovigilance)
jobs_results.description:
The Junior Python Developer, Pharmacovigilance (PV) Solutions will be responsible for day-to-day python development and oversight of TransPerfect’s proprietary tools, updating and maintaining code, and may be in daily and regular contact with internal clients including project managers and pharmacovigilance specialists who utilize the tools on a daily basis.

Job description:
• Write code to build web crawlers for our clients’ selected local literature websites
• Write code to help maintain web crawler and other applications, address bugs, and work on new features
• Perform regular maintenance on crawlers to ensure optimal performance on all crawlers
• Maintain excellent records via Request Tracker, in line with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP) best practices, with a strong focus on Good Documentation Practice
• Assist Project Managers with all technical aspects of their day to day workflows, learn and become an expert-level user of all TPT technologies utilized for the local... literature monitoring service including but not limited to:

o TPT crawler

o TLS Express

o Digital Reef

o Relativity

o Trial Interactive
• Grow existing client relationships through service and technology-led development
• Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor

Required skills:
• Superior written and spoken communication skills in English
• Proficiency writing code in Python
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
• Aptitude to learn and excel in various technology mediums
• Exceptional problem-solving and critical thinking skills
• Excellent attention to detail to ensure high-quality deliverables to client

Required experience and qualifications:
• Minimum Bachelor’s degree
• Minimum 1-2 years of python experience or within the tech industry

Desired skills and experience:
• Able to multitask in a fast-paced environment
• Experience with web crawling/web scraping a/o browser automation methods and technologies (specifically Selenium and Requests)
• Proficiency with Git for version control

By applying, I confirm I have read and accept TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting

jobs_results.title: Programador Python con conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial
jobs_results.description:
Humeco, líder en biotecnologías reproductivas para el mundo animal, está buscando una persona para unirse a nuestro equipo de I+D+i., Estamos dedicados a innovar en el campo de la visión por computador y la inteligencia artificial para el mundo veterinario.

Buscamos un Desarrollador Junior con interés en el análisis de imágenes y la IA.

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones de software con enfoque en visión por computador y análisis de imágenes usando Python.

Participar en el desarrollo e implantación de modelos de inteligencia artificial para proyectos veterinarios.

Colaborar en la integración de aplicaciones con tecnologías Docker y Flutter, con especial énfasis en Tkinter para el desarrollo de interfaces gráficas.

Contribuir en todas las fases del ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software, desde la concepción hasta el despliegue.

Trabajar en colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para idear soluciones innovadoras y eficientes.

Requisitos:
• Graduado/a en... Informática, formación profesional o estudios relacionados.
• Conocimientos sólidos en Python
• Librerias de visión por computador (ej. OpenCV) son un plus.
• Experiencia o familiaridad con inteligencia artificial y análisis de imágenes.
• Conocimientos básicos de Docker y Flutter.
• Se valorará experiencia con Tkinter
• Capacidad para trabajar en equipo
• Ofrecemos:
• Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos innovadores y de alto impacto.
• Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y de apoyo para el desarrollo profesional.
• Puesto semipresencial 20 presencial 80 en remoto

Salario: 25.000€ - 30.000€ Bruto/año

jobs_results.title: Python Developer Solutions
jobs_results.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 300 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ 11,000 people and operate in more than 55 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share-and-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.

What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.

Python RPA Developer Asset Productivity & Control

Location – Madrid

Major/Key Accountabilities

Our Asset Control function is seeking for a Data... solutions Developer/Python Developer to assist with continued implementation of new applications that can help us optimize the use of our assets (reduce losses, undercover patters and anticipate to issues).

You will work on automation and adjust solutions to regional requirements in partnership with different functions across Brambles.

You will be working with previously developed ML models to create a final application that meet CHEP regional needs coupled with any data analysis required to support implementations or changes.
• Partner with business teams to identify & propose solutions to automate time consuming processes.
• Develop, deploy and maintain automations.
• Propose process standardizations within Asset Control.
• Monitor own completion of workload and meet objectives.
• Work closely with all internal stakeholders to ensure automations cover business requirements.
• Ensure stability and scalability of automations.
• Create internal documentation about automations created.
• Set up automatic alerts to identify errors in the automations.
• Qualifications
• Technology related degree and/or a minimum of 4 years working experience in a similar role.

Experience
• Comfortable presenting solutions and interacting with senior management.
• Experience developing and streamlining automation processes.
• Experience using any RPA tool (desirable BluePrism).
• 4+ years professional experience in developing APIs and automations on Python.
• Experience working with cloud platform providers like Amazon Web Services (Lambda, S3, Databricks, etc.)
• Solid understanding of Version Control principles (Git)
• Experience translating requirements into actionable business solutions.
• Worked with measures and KPIs.
• Working on remote teams.
• Proved experience with Project Management (manage priorities, standardization, automation, troubleshooting and short-term planning).
• Effectiveness reducing workload on business processes.
• Experience implementing solution from scratch.
• Programming experience focused to automation (webscrapping, macros, etc).

· 3+ years professional experience developing data-driven solutions in Python.

·

Languages

English

Spanish

jobs_results.title: Python Developer Junior
jobs_results.description:
Tus Objetivos

Estamos ampliando nuestra área de Tecnología y vamos a incorporar a nuestro equipo un programador / desarrollador para liderar el desarrollo de aplicaciones y su integración con capacidad de recoger los requisitos de negocio para ofrecer soluciones con el objetivo de proporcionar a las distintas áreas de negocio de las herramientas necesarias que permitan el crecimiento de la compañía en base a las líneas estratégicas establecidas.

Integrándose en el equipo de tecnología de Switch Energía su misión consistirá en identificar necesidades, proponer mejoras e implantarlas en todas las áreas de negocio de la compañía, desarrollando herramientas Python principalmente.

¿Qué vas a hacer?
• Análisis funcional de requisitos.
• Diseño de aplicaciones.
• Planificación con foco en metodología ágiles.
• Desarrollo de aplicaciones con Python.
• Análisis funcional de requisitos.
• Desarrollo de CRM con Odoo.

¿Qué necesitas?

Requisitos: ☑️⤵️
• Experiencia previa de al menos 1 año... con cualquier lenguaje de programación. ☑️
• Deseable experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones con SQL,Python, Odoo, Pandas, Elasticsearch✍️ ☑️
• Proactivo, con buenas cualidades comunicativas y de trabajo en equipo☑️
• Autonomía y capacidad para integrarse en un equipo dinámico, ágil y comprometido ☑️

¿Por qué nosotros?

¿Quieres dar un salto a tu carrera profesional y convertirte en un experto Python Developer?

Si tienes más de 1 año de experiencia en Python a nivel de desarrollo e integración de servicios, !este es tu momento y tu oferta!

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato Indefinido.
• Salario acorde con la experiencia del candidato. ⚖️
• Jornada de trabajo flexible.
• Cultura de mejora continua.
• Un gran ambiente de trabajo donde todos somos importantes y apostamos por el desarrollo profesional.
• 3 días de trabajo presencial y 2 de teletrabajo. (Trabajo híbrido)
• Horario: de lunes a jueves de 8,30 a 17,30 y viernes de 8,30 a 14,30 h.
• Ubicación: Ciudad de la Imagen, Pozuelo de Alarcón

¿Quiénes somos?

Nuestra empresa nació en 2019 a partir de un grupo de profesionales que, con una larga experiencia en el sector, consideraba que había que proponer algo distinto; dar un buen servicio no es cambiar de comercializadora en la factura, es entender sus necesidades, analizar el uso y el consumo, desarrollar una propuesta técnica y hacer seguimiento de ella.

Nuestro buen hacer, como del empresario en su negocio, ha sido la clave de nuestro crecimiento.

Tenemos claro que el empresario no necesita más problemas, y menos con la energía, necesita soluciones rápidas y eficaces

Nuestra empresa nació en 2019 a partir de un grupo de profesionales que, con una larga experiencia en el sector, consideraba que había que proponer algo distinto; dar un buen servicio no es cambiar de comercializadora en la factura, es entender sus necesidades, analizar el uso y el consumo, desarrollar una propuesta técnica y hacer seguimiento de ella.

Nuestro buen hacer, como del empresario en su negocio, ha sido la clave de nuestro crecimiento.

Tenemos claro que el empresario no necesita más problemas, y menos con la energía, necesita soluciones rápidas y eficaces

jobs_results.description:
Our Mission: Powering Innovation That Drives Human Advancement

When visionary companies need to know how their world-changing ideas will perform, they close the gap between design and reality with Ansys simulation. For more than 50 years, Ansys software has enabled innovators across industries to push boundaries by using the predictive power of simulation. From sustainable transportation to advanced semiconductors, from satellite systems to life-saving medical devices, the next great leaps in human advancement will be powered by Ansys.

Innovate With Ansys, Power Your Career.

Summary / Role Purpose

The Python developer is responsible for the development of software products and supporting systems. In this role, the Python developer will use advanced technical and problem-solving skills to design, develop, and deploy software applications for on-prem and cloud platforms using containerization technologies.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Participates in planning, architecture... and research around on-prem and cloud deployments.
• Performs complex development activities that may require extensive analysis in areas including user experience, software design and solver research.
• Performs complex bug verification, release testing and beta support for assigned products. Researches problems discovered by QA or product support and develops solutions.
• Researches and understands the marketing requirements for a product, including target environment, performance criteria and competitive issues. May work with strategic customers or proxies to assess needs and develop solutions.
• Works independently with minimal supervision and may take on some planning and mentoring responsibilities.
• May be responsible for managing interns or co-ops but typically does not have direct reports.

Minimum Education/Certification Requirements and Experience
• BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or Quantitative Sciences with at least 5 years of commercial experience in software development.
• At least 2 years of Python experience in a commercial setting.
• Experience with REST APIs and Cloud services implementation and deployment.
• Proficiency in automated testing and CI/CD practices.
• Value-oriented, self-motivated, fast learner.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills
• Excellent technical knowledge and commercial experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
• Experience delivering reusable microservices and related client libraries for use by a large number of end-user applications across a range of deployment environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
• Experience developing reusable microservices and related client libraries for use by a large number of end-user applications across a range of deployment environments.
• Knowledge of or experience with Agile SDLC and DevOps processes and tools.
• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

At Ansys, we know that changing the world takes vision, skill, and each other. We fuel new ideas, build relationships, and help each other realize our greatest potential. We are ONE Ansys. We operate on three key components: the commitments to our stakeholders, the behaviors of how we work together, and the actions of how we deliver results. Together as ONE Ansys, we are powering innovation that drives human advancement.

Our Commitments:
• Amaze with innovative products and solutions
• Make our customers incredibly successful
• Act with integrity
• Ensure employees thrive and shareholders prosper

Our Values:
• Adaptability: Be open, welcome what's next
• Courage: Be courageous, move forward passionately
• Generosity: Be generous, share, listen, serve
• Authenticity: Be you, make us stronger

Our Actions:
• We commit to audacious goals
• We work seamlessly as a team
• We demonstrate mastery
• We deliver outstanding results

INCLUSION IS AT OUR CORE

We believe diverse thinking leads to better outcomes. We are committed to creating and nurturing a workplace that fuels this by welcoming people, no matter their background, identity, or experience, to a workplace where they are valued and where diversity, inclusion, equity, and belonging thrive.

WELCOME WHAT’S NEXT IN YOUR CAREER AT ANSYS

At Ansys, you will find yourself among the sharpest minds and most visionary leaders across the globe. Collectively we strive to change the world with innovative technology and transformational solutions. With a prestigious reputation in working with well-known, world-class companies, standards at Ansys are high — met by those willing to rise to the occasion and meet those challenges head on. Our team is passionate about pushing the limits of world-class simulation technology, empowering our customers to turn their design concepts into successful, innovative products faster and at a lower cost.

At Ansys, it’s about the learning, the discovery, and the collaboration. It’s about the “what’s next” as much as the “mission accomplished.” And it’s about the melding of disciplined intellect with strategic direction and results that have, can, and do impact real people in real ways. All this is forged within a working environment built on respect, autonomy, and ethics.

CREATING A PLACE WE’RE PROUD TO BE

Ansys is an S&P 500 company and a member of the NASDAQ-100. We are proud to have been recognized for the following more recent awards, although our list goes on: Newsweek’s Most Loved Workplace globally and in the U.S., Gold Stevie Award Winner, America’s Most Responsible Companies, Fast Company World Changing Ideas, Great Place to Work Certified (Belgium, China, Greece, France, India, Japan, Korea, Spain, Sweden, Taiwan, and U.K.).

For more information, please visit us at www.ansys.com

Ansys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Ansys does not accept unsolicited referrals for vacancies, and any unsolicited referral will become the property of Ansys. Upon hire, no fee will be owed to the agency, person, or entity

jobs_results.title: Analista Programador/a Python Spyder
jobs_results.description:
Descripción:

¡Seguimos sumando talento a nuestro Centro de Excelencia Tecnológico RDT Tech!

¿Sabéis que en RDT innovamos y desarrollamos las mejores soluciones tecnológicas del mercado?

Esta vez ampliaremos nuestro equipo de Desarrollo de SW, dentro de nuestra línea de servicios en el sector de la energía, con un nuevo rol: Analista Programador/a Python donde el entorno de programación vendrá definido con Spyder.

El proyecto en el participarás:

Desarrollo de aplicación de monitorización de Bancos de Ensayo de Convertidores de Potencia

Nos gustaría que pudieras aportarnos…
• Experiencia en programación en Python.
• Conocimientos de Python Spyder como entorno de desarrollo integrado (IDE) para escribir, probar y depurar código Python.
• Se valorará experiencia en análisis de datos, puesto que la aplicación recogerá datos (CSV, TEXT…) de aplicativos SCADA.
• Base de Datos SQL Lite.

Otros datos de interés:
• Teletrabajo 70% - Cerca de Zamudio (Bizkaia)
• Ingles de trabajo (nivel... medio) necesario para estar alineado con documentación técnica.
• Contarás con un contrato indefinido.
• Horario flexible respetando las "horas core" definido por el equipo/proyecto.

Requisitos:

Por nuestra parte decirte, que:
• Formarás del equipo de RDT Tech dentro de una organización con un horizonte real de crecimiento y posicionamiento increíble.
• Podrás trabajar de forma híbrida.
• Equipo de personas y proyecto muy top a la vanguardia en el ámbito del desarrollo de SW.
• Otros beneficios como Campus de formación continuo con foco tecnológico, seguro de salud, etc.
